bagPolicy.summary: For the Morgan Wallen concerts, the university allowed one clear bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or a one-gallon clear bag, plus a clutch up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. No other bags were permitted except small medical bags; check guidance for the next concert.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For the 2024 Morgan Wallen shows, campus lots with concert passes opened at 2 p.m. and university buses switched to event service then. Those times are specific to those shows.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup point in its Morgan Wallen concert guidance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The official Neyland concert guide for Garth Brooks says concession stands are throughout the concourses. It does not publish offerings or prices for other concerts.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Garth Brooks concert guide designated accessible elevators and entry at Gates 15 and 21 for that show. Confirm the entry arrangement for the next concert.

reEntry.summary: The official Garth Brooks concert guide stated that guests could not leave Neyland Stadium and be readmitted. Check the next concert’s event-specific policy.

ticketPickup.summary: The university’s Morgan Wallen concert guidance said general-bowl tickets used the Ticketmaster app and premium tickets used the Tennessee Athletics app. It did not provide a will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For the September 2024 Morgan Wallen concerts, gates opened at 4:30 p.m. for 6:30 p.m. shows. Future concert gate times must be checked on that concert’s event page.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
